CONDITIONING Efiiects on Marking,. EncapsuIaticc 7.1 Method 1 : Superficial item shall be completely immcrscd in OIIC of the Coating, Etc -The solvents ( see 4 ) maintained at specified temperature [ see 5.1(a) J and for the time as specified in 5.1 (b). After removal of the item from the solvent the item shall be allowed to dry for at least 5 minutes. Then the marking area shall be rubbed with brush or cotton. WOOI or with wrapping tissue paper to determihe the durability of the marking. Ten strokes, 2 x 5 in 2 shall be applied over the marking area with a force opposite directions, of zpproximately 5 N. New cotton wool or wrapping tissue paper shali be used for each item to be tested. 7.1.1 Application of Dt$erent Test Conditions or Methodr to the Same Type of Component - When a type of component or part is to be tested under different test conditions. or methods, separate items should be used for each test. 7.2 Method 2 : Effects on the Characteristics of the Item - The item shall be completely immersed in one of the solvents ( szc 4 ) at one of the temperatures given in 5.1(a) and for the time given in 5.1(b). 8.
